g.text: Network first, identity second, permission third — a failure at any gate returns the same 403
1 network rules — is this IP or subnet allowed?
2 authentication — account key, SAS, or Entra token?
3 authorization — does that identity hold the data action?
why an account key is worse than it looks
a caller with the account key clears gate 2 and never faces gate 3
-> RBAC cannot restrict it, the audit log cannot name the person
--allow-shared-key-access false # forces every caller through Entra ID
